'''Star Tours Flight 212''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight that traveled to [[Berchest/Legends|Berchest]], [[Garos IV]] and [[Telerath/Legends|Telerath]]. On the morning of the [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138]], the flight landed at the spaceport at 0715 hours. It was scheduled to depart again at 0810.
